entities.summary: Niulakita is the southernmost island of Tuvalu, and also the name of the only village on this island. Niulakita has a population of 36. The residents of Niulakita have moved to the island from Niutao. Niulakita is represented in the Parliament of Tuvalu by the members of the constituency of Niutao.
